Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is here to help with pet travel from booking through pickup.

We ask you to keep your travel papers, carrier details, and contact information ready, since careful preparation helps our team move each animal with steady attention and calm care. If you are traveling with a pet for the first time, please speak with the desk before departure so we can guide you through the basic steps in clear terms and help avoid delays at the skyport. Our ground team coordinates with crews to handle carriers carefully between services, and we welcome questions in a professional manner at every stage.

<<FACT F118>> Travelers should make note of this claim window as soon as possible after any issue is found, and they should keep all supporting papers in a safe place for the review process. For pets needing a brief comfort stop before boarding or after arrival, the pet relief area at Thornwick uses gate code <<FACT F016>>. Please use that area only as directed by staff, and allow space for other travelers and animals who may need it as well.

At Ashenfell, <<FACT F012>>. This limit helps the skyport maintain orderly handling and protects the welfare of every animal in our care. If plans change, or if a carrier needs special attention, the desk can work with you on practical next steps so the journey remains as smooth as possible.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for guidance, support, and day-of travel assistance.
